parameters.help_en: The IDs of the delivery channels. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 投递渠道ID。多个投递渠道ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: delivery_channel_ids

AccountId.description_en: The current Alibaba Cloud account ID

CompliantSnapshot.description_en:
Specifies whether to receive compliance snapshots. Cloud Config delivers resource compliance and non-compliance information to Simple Log Service. Valid values:
true: Receives compliance snapshots.
false: Does not receive compliance snapshots
CompliantSnapshot.description_zh:
是否接收合规快照。配置审计向日志服务SLS投递资源合规和不合规信息。取值：
true：接收合规快照。
false：不接收合规快照

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification.description_en:
Specifies whether to receive resource configuration history. When a resource configuration changes, Cloud Config delivers the resource configuration history to OSS, Simple Log Service, or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Valid values:
true: Receives resource configuration history.
false: Does not receive resource configuration history
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification.description_zh:
是否接收资源配置变更历史。当资源配置变更时，配置审计向对象存储OSS、日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源配置变更历史。取值：
true：接收资源配置变更历史。
false：不接收资源配置变更历史

ConfigurationSnapshot.description_en:
Specifies whether to receive scheduled resource snapshots. Cloud Config delivers scheduled resource snapshots to OSS or Simple Log Service at `04:00Z` and `16:00Z` (UTC) every day. Valid values:
true: Receives scheduled resource snapshots.
false: Does not receive scheduled resource snapshots
ConfigurationSnapshot.description_zh:
是否接收资源定时快照。每天`04:00Z`和`16:00Z`（UTC时间），配置审计定时向对象存储OSS或SLS投递资源定时快照。取值：
true：接收资源定时快照。
false：不接收资源定时快照

DeliveryChannelAssumeRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role assumed by the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelCondition.description_en:
The additional rules for the delivery channel. Currently, all deliveries to MNS channels and snapshot deliveries to SLS channels are supported.

If you specify the minimum risk level and resource types for MNS event subscription, the details are as follows:

The minimum risk level for event subscription is `{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`.

     
    `value` indicates the risk level that you want to filter. Valid values: 1 for high risk, 2 for medium risk, and 3 for low risk.

The resource types for event subscription are `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.
    
      
    `values` indicates the resource types of the events that you want to subscribe to. It is a JSON array of resource types.
    Example:
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

If you specify the resource types for SLS snapshot delivery, the resource types are `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.
    
      
    `values` indicates the resource types that you want to deliver. It is a JSON array of resource types.
    Example:
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`
DeliveryChannelCondition.description_zh:
投递渠道附加规则。当前支持MNS渠道的所有投递和SLS渠道的快照投递。

如果您指定MNS订阅事件的最低风险等级和资源类型，具体如下：

订阅事件的最低风险等级为`{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`。

     
    `value`表示您需要过滤的风险等级。取值：1表示高风险，2表示中风险，3表示低风险。

订阅事件的资源类型为`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
    
      
    `values`表示您需要订阅事件的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。
    例如：
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

如果您指定SLS快照投递的资源类型，资源类型为`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
    
      
    `values`表示您需要投递的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。
    例如：
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

DeliveryChannelId.description_en: The ID of the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelName.description_en: The name of the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelTargetArn.description_en:
The ARN of the delivery destination.

If DeliveryChannelType is set to OSS, this parameter specifies the ARN of the OSS bucket.

If DeliveryChannelType is set to MNS, this parameter specifies the ARN of the MNS topic.

If DeliveryChannelType is set to SLS, this parameter specifies the ARN of the Logstore
DeliveryChannelTargetArn.description_zh:
投递渠道目标地址的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为OSS时，该参数为Bucket的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为MNS时，该参数为Topic的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为SLS时，该参数为Logstore的ARN

DeliveryChannelType.description_en:
The type of the delivery channel. Valid values:
OSS: Object Storage Service. 
MNS: Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS).
SLS: Simple Log Service
DeliveryChannelType.description_zh:
投递渠道类型。取值：
OSS：对象存储。 
MNS：轻量消息队列（原 MNS）。
SLS：日志服务

DeliverySnapshotTime.description_en:
The daily start time for delivering scheduled resource snapshots.

The format is `HH:mmZ` (UTC)
DeliverySnapshotTime.description_zh:
资源定时快照每日开始投递的时间。

格式为`HH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the delivery channel

NonCompliantNotification.description_en:
Specifies whether to receive resource non-compliance events. When a resource is non-compliant, Cloud Config delivers resource non-compliance events to Simple Log Service or Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS). Valid values: 
true: Receives resource non-compliance events.
false: Does not receive resource non-compliance events
NonCompliantNotification.description_zh:
是否接收资源不合规事件。当资源不合规时，配置审计向日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源不合规事件。取值： 
true：接收资源不合规事件。
false：不接收资源不合规事件

OversizedDataOSSTargetArn.description_en: The ARN of the OSS bucket where oversized delivery data is stored when the data exceeds the limit of the delivery channel
OversizedDataOSSTargetArn.description_zh: 当投递数据超过投递渠道限制时，投递数据转存到对象存储OSS的目标存储空间

Status.description_en:
The status of the delivery setting. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
Status.description_zh:
投递设置状态。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启
